text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Morocco to participate in Ottawa's meeting on security of chemical products.
- Libyan Industry Minister Muftah Azzouz visits several industrial plants in Casablanca.
- Joint-committee on cooperation between Iran and Morocco to meet next week in Rabat.
- Prime Minister Abdellatif Filali urges local oil companies to rebuild the country's security stocks.
- University Minister Driss Khalil outlines university reforms.
